main.description: Trigger a Sentinel STAC ingest run. Searches Sentinel-2 L2A (Element84) + Sentinel-1 GRD (Copernicus) catalogs over the configured AOIs, persists each matching scene as com.etzhayyim.apps.maps.satelliteScene records. Timer-start BPMN sentinelIngest.bpmn invokes this same NSID for the daily R/PT24H run; manual POST is allowed for backfill. ADR-2604271800.

aois.description: Optional override AOI list (geohash strings or bbox 'minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat'). Falls back to env MAPS_SENTINEL_AOIS.

timeRangeDays.description: Look back N days from now. Default 1 (matches R/PT24H cadence).

maxScenesPerAoi.description: Cap scenes returned per AOI per platform.

maxCloudCover.description: Max cloud cover percent for optical scenes.
